Build against API version v1 (S21) with base path AX-81436 and error format AX-90930. The older api_version facts from sprints S01-S20 (v2..v40) are earlier sprints' values; the S21 facts are current and match repo/api.py.

Use the security team's scheme (JWT bearer tokens, RS256, 15 minute expiry) for all user traffic; it governs over Globex's long-lived X-Api-Key request, since long-lived static keys are weaker. Globex's request is not rejected: for their non-interactive back-office scripts we will follow up with a separate, scoped machine-credential option (e.g. short-lived tokens via a client-credentials style exchange), to be designed and reviewed by security.
Adopt API v2 as the Acme Notes API version, per the researcher's updated api_version fact (S21: v2); it governs over older api_version facts from earlier sprints.

Approve the CRUD spec: it is consistent with the current S21 API version v2. Recall found no S21 authentication fact, only earlier-sprint auth facts (S01-S03), which do not govern S21, so auth is not covered by this approval. Code settings were read from the repo.
Approve the CRUD spec: it matches the current S21 API version v2. No S21 authentication fact was recalled, so auth is unchecked.
